title: Iron Man / X-O Manowar in Heavy Metal
overview:
Iron Man and X-O Manowar, of the metal titan clan, stand against a crisis threatening the universe! The battle at the end of the century is here now! Surging action! The ultimate superheroes!! This is the final drama!!!

Suit up as Marvel's Iron Man or the armored warrior X-O Manowar in this side-scrolling action game, alone or with a friend. Blast and brawl your way through eight missions, from a nuclear plant siege and Stark Enterprises to the streets of New York, Arnim Zola's castle and an alien dig site, battling super-villains such as Titania, Melter, Mr. Hyde, Absorbing Man and Baron Zemo.

- Two-direction firepower and Iron Man's chest beam blast
- Multi-hit combos and shooting into the screen
- Power up your weapons
- Huge boss battles and an asteroid-smashing space stage
- Two-player simultaneous play

メタルタイタン族、アイアンマンとXOマノワーが宇宙の危機に立ち向かう！世紀末の戦いがいまここに！怒濤のアクション！究極のスーパーヒーロー！！これは最期のドラマだ！！！
